title: Interfaces
description:
Public functions of MIPP, one entry per function. The generator derives from it the names and the signatures in the three APIs: `mipp_add_float32`, `mipp_add_float32_maskz`, `mipp_add_float32_m2` in C, `mipp::add` in C++.

Checked when the file is loaded: `proto_ref` exists in `registry_protos.json`, the function has a scalar implementation for each of its datatypes and mask variants ([Scalar Implementations](scalar_implems.md)), and it is in at most one category ([Categories](categories.md)).

datatypes.description: Datatypes of the function: an alias of `DATATYPES_MAP` (`helpers_headers/tools.py`), such as `all_datatypes`, `all_float`, `all_int`, `all_uint`, `all_32bit`, or a pair alias for the conversions (`all_datatypes_same_size`, `all_datatypes_widenning`, ...), or an explicit list.

horizontal.description: `true` for the functions that combine the lanes of a register (reductions such as `hadd`, `hmax`). Their LMUL > 1 versions come from the `lmulh` generic templates instead of two calls on halves.

variants.description: Variants of the function: `u` (unmasked, always present), `m` (Merge-Masked), `z` (Zero-Masked), `s` (Source-Masked). `["u"]`: no mask variant; `["u", "m", "z", "s"]`: all of them.

cpp_name.description: Name of the function in the C++ APIs when it differs from the C name: `get_k` is `mipp::get`.
